name: Elon Musk
text: The best part is no part. The best process is no process. Before you optimize anything, ask whether it should exist at all. Most engineering teams spend years perfecting things that should have been deleted.

name: Elon Musk
text: Making life multiplanetary is the insurance policy for consciousness. Every rocket we land and reuse brings that future a little closer.

name: Elon Musk
text: Hiring tip: look for evidence of exceptional ability, not degrees. Ask candidates about the hardest problem they solved and how they solved it.

name: Satya Nadella
text: Empathy is not a soft skill. It is the core of innovation. When we truly understand the unmet needs of our customers, we build products that matter. Grateful to our teams who lead with curiosity every day.

name: Satya Nadella
text: Every company is now a software company. The question is not whether to adopt AI, but how fast you can build the culture to use it well.

name: Satya Nadella
text: A growth mindset beats a know-it-all culture. We moved from being know-it-alls to learn-it-alls, and it changed everything.

name: Bill Gates
text: I just finished reading a fascinating book on climate innovation. The biggest takeaway: we already have many of the tools we need, but scaling them affordably is the real challenge. Here are 3 breakthroughs I'm optimistic about.

name: Bill Gates
text: Vaccines are one of the best investments in human history. Every dollar spent on childhood immunization returns many times over in health and productivity.

name: Bill Gates
text: AI tutors could give every student in the world access to personalized learning. This is one of the most exciting uses of the technology I've seen.

name: Sundar Pichai
text: AI is one of the most profound technologies humanity is working on. Our responsibility is to make it helpful for everyone, while building it boldly and responsibly. Excited to share what our teams have been working on.

name: Sundar Pichai
text: I grew up in Chennai with limited access to technology. Getting my first phone changed my life. That's why making technology accessible matters so much to me.

name: Sundar Pichai
text: Quantum computing just took another step forward. The problems we'll be able to solve in medicine and materials science are truly exciting.

name: Simon Sinek
text: Leaders are not responsible for the job. Leaders are responsible for the people who are responsible for the job. Take care of your people, and they will take care of the work.

name: Simon Sinek
text: People don't buy what you do, they buy why you do it. If your team can't explain your why, your customers won't feel it either.

name: Simon Sinek
text: Friendship at work matters. A team that trusts each other will outperform a team of talented strangers every single time.

name: Gary Vaynerchuk
text: Stop worrying about what people think of you. Seriously. The amount of time you waste caring about other people's opinions is the time you could be building your dream. Patience plus execution. That's the game.

name: Gary Vaynerchuk
text: Attention is the asset. Wherever people's eyeballs are, that's where your brand needs to be. Right now, that's short-form video.

name: Gary Vaynerchuk
text: Kindness is a strategy. Being nice in business isn't weakness. It's the long game, and the long game always wins.

name: Richard Branson
text: If somebody offers you an amazing opportunity but you are not sure you can do it, say yes, then learn how to do it later. Some of my best adventures started exactly this way.

name: Richard Branson
text: Train people well enough so they can leave, treat them well enough so they don't want to. Your employees come first, customers second.

name: Richard Branson
text: Just spent a beautiful morning kitesurfing before work. Taking care of your body and mind is the best business decision you can make.
